question: Consider $$A=\begin{bmatrix}2&0&0\\0&-1&0\\0&0&3\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}-2&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&-3\end{bmatrix}$$ and the identity matrix $I_3$. Evaluate $P=A+B$ and $Q=A-B+2I_3$, and classify the resulting matrices $P$ and $Q$ by examining their entries.
explanation:
Evaluation of $P$

Adding the corresponding elements of $A$ and $B$, $$P=A+B=\begin{bmatrix}2&0&0\\0&-1&0\\0&0&3\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&-3\end{bmatrix}$$ $$P=\begin{bmatrix}0&0&0\\0&0&0\\0&0&0\end{bmatrix}=O$$ Thus, $P$ is the zero matrix of order $3\times3$.

Evaluation of $Q$

Since $$A-B=\begin{bmatrix}4&0&0\\0&-2&0\\0&0&6\end{bmatrix}$$ and $$2I_3=\begin{bmatrix}2&0&0\\0&2&0\\0&0&2\end{bmatrix},$$ we obtain $$Q=A-B+2I_3=\begin{bmatrix}6&0&0\\0&0&0\\0&0&8\end{bmatrix}$$ All non-diagonal entries of $Q$ are zero, so $Q$ is a diagonal matrix. Its diagonal elements are not all equal, so it is not a scalar matrix, and since its diagonal elements are not all $1$, it is not an identity matrix.

Final Result

Therefore, $$P=O$$ is a zero matrix and $$Q=\begin{bmatrix}6&0&0\\0&0&0\\0&0&8\end{bmatrix}$$ is a diagonal matrix.
